prefill: serial tokens; vocabulary projection only at final prompt token
cache_state: warm model file pages; fresh process and cache state per run
decode_rate_definition: (generated tokens - 1) / decode_seconds; first output uses prefill logits
memory_definition: getrusage peak RSS; smaps_rollup at registered role cadence;100ms VmRSS/VmSwap/MemAvailable sampling
eos_policy: ignore EOS in both for fixed-size throughput measurement
ttft_definition: main request start to first nonempty token piece fully written to stdout; includes tokenization, loading, prompt processing, argmax and output; excludes exec/loader before main
full_process_time_definition: parent launch to observed child exit; includes cleanup and up to100ms polling delay, separate from in-process request time
hardware_notes: 4 GB Raspberry Pi 4 Model B Rev 1.5, Cortex-A72; 1.8 GHz observed under the existing ondemand governor
